notes: The reconciliation cases of PV-HIST-002 (accepted by PV-REV-HIST-002), transcribed from its permanent conformance cases and adopted in 0.2.0 under integrity.bands.v1+ci-unit-004+hist-002. Each states the carried history as the observation a build adds from its immediate predecessor (ci.revision_history_carried, lineage devostasis.ci-history.v2 unless the case is about another lineage) and the current revision records in the adapter's shape. The chain cases, HIST-08, -12, -17, -18 and -20, and the store replay of HIST-13 need a history store and are tests (tests/test_revision_history.py). HIST-14 needs an accepted migration, and none exists. observed_at is 2026-09-10T12:00:00Z, so the window starts at 2026-08-27T12:00:00Z.

vectors.title: a revision a prior bundle proved failing stays FAILURE_OBSERVED when the provider now shows the same revision passing; the current verdict is PASS
vectors.notes: A re-requested check suite keeps its id and shows only its latest outcome; the failure the previous bundle observed is what keeps the revision failing (R54's rule across bundles).

vectors.title: a revision the prior bundle recorded PASS_ONLY_OBSERVED becomes FAILURE_OBSERVED when a failure of it is newly observed, and stays there
vectors.notes: The run the previous bundle saw pass (41) is no longer listed; the new run 42 failed on the same revision.

vectors.title: a prior failure plus any number of same-revision retries that passed is one failed contribution, whatever the number or order of the retries
a failed revision and a newer passing revision are two samples while both are in the window
a failure the provider no longer exposes stays historical evidence while its revision is in the window
without durable history a parent-level pass cannot prove the earlier attempts: UNKNOWN_HISTORY, no favorable PASS_ONLY reconstruction
complete attempt-level current evidence with no unresolved prior gap proves PASS_ONLY_OBSERVED
the same failure in durable history and in the current enumeration is one failed contribution, never two
a revision whose durable failure has aged beyond the 14-day window no longer contributes
vectors.notes: The aged revision is also absent from the durable output of this bundle; the bundle that proved it keeps it.

vectors.title: equivalent failure histories on the Actions and the check-suite surfaces, in any enumeration order, give the identical record and result
vectors.notes: GitLab-equivalent evidence (the third surface the case names) needs a GitLab adapter this version does not have.

vectors.title: carried history of the older lineage is replayed from the attempts it kept, never copied from the state it derived: its failure stays, its parent-level pass is unknown
vectors.notes: devostasis.ci-history.v1 is the revision record 0.1.x bundles carry in ci.revision_verdicts_14d: its attempts are canonical, so the union is rebuilt from them under the current lineage. The 0.1.x record called r2 PASS_ONLY_OBSERVED from a check suite; R52 does not, and replay applies it.

vectors.title: carried history of a lineage with neither replay nor an accepted migration leaves the revisions it names unknown, until complete current evidence repairs them
a prior bundle's current verdict is never inherited: the revision the provider no longer shows keeps its history and speaks for nothing current
vectors.notes: r is the newest revision and failed in the previous bundle; with no current verification it contributes its failure and is not the current reference.

vectors.title: a prior UNKNOWN_HISTORY does not heal because the provider now shows a pass that is complete only for what is visible

variants.title: a check suite that passes now
